chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ṣafwān, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man performing wudu (ablution) and beginning with the left before the right, he عليه السلام said: “He should wash the right, and repeat the left.”

key_terms.الْيَسَارَ: the left side or left hand
key_terms.الْيَمِينَ: the right side or right hand
key_terms.بِالشِّمَالِ: with the left side or left hand
key_terms.قَبْلَ الْيَمِينِ: before the right side or right hand

ai.seo_question: What should someone do in wudu (ablution) if he washed the left before the right?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the order of washing in wudu (ablution). If a person begins with the left hand before the right, he must wash the right hand and then repeat washing the left in order to restore the proper sequence.
